sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
The core gameplay mechanics of Crab & Fish are simple and easy to understand. The game takes place on a grid where you have to use your mouse, keyboard, or touch controls to move a crab around to free the trapped fishes. The crab can be moved in different directions, and you can use the environment to your advantage by using the grid to bounce the crab off the walls and onto the trapped fishes.

The game requires timing and precision, as you have to time your movements correctly to free the fishes without getting stuck. The game also includes obstacles such as rocks and other environmental hazards that you need to avoid. The game's physics engine is well-designed, providing a smooth and realistic experience.

One of the key features of the game is the use of gravity, which adds an extra layer of challenge to the game. The game also includes different types of fishes, each with their own unique characteristics and challenges. The game's goal is to free as many fishes as possible within the time limit, and the more fishes you free, the higher your score will be.

The game's simplicity makes it accessible to players of all ages, and the game's challenge level increases as you progress through the levels. The game also includes power-ups and bonuses that can be used to increase your score or make the game easier.

Overall, the core gameplay mechanics of Crab & Fish are simple yet challenging, making it an excellent choice for anyone looking for a fun and addictive puzzle game.
